data: How many methods are presented in the plots?

The figure contains two subfigures, each showing three different methods represented by distinct lines or markers. The left subfigure shows three methods: Temperature (red line), Generator Rejection (green line), and Beam Search (blue dot). Similarly, the right subfigure also shows these same three methods: Temperature (red line), Generator Rejection (green line), and Beam Search (blue dot). Therefore, there are three methods presented in the plots.
